# FirstClick Homepage Headline Generator

> A free, open-source, local-only browser tool for generating homepage headline directions, a supporting line, and a primary CTA.

Live tool: https://elyasibkr.github.io/firstclick-headline-generator/
Source: https://github.com/ELYASIBKR/firstclick-headline-generator
License: MIT
Shopify hero copy examples: https://elyasibkr.github.io/firstclick-headline-generator/shopify-hero-copy-examples.html
Shopify homepage CTA examples: https://elyasibkr.github.io/firstclick-headline-generator/shopify-homepage-cta-examples.html
Service-business homepage examples: https://elyasibkr.github.io/firstclick-headline-generator/service-business-homepage-examples.html
Illustrative First Screen Fix deliverable: https://elyasibkr.github.io/firstclick-headline-generator/first-screen-fix-sample.html
Optional self-guided DIY kit preview (three workbook pages before a $29 purchase): https://firstclick-fix.ppjdmpk.chatgpt.site/firstclick-diy-kit-preview.pdf

The tool requires no login, sends no inputs over the network, uses no analytics or ads, and has no dependencies or build step.

For one free, site-specific homepage finding with no purchase obligation, send your homepage URL and the action you want visitors to take:
mailto:ppjdmpk@gmail.com?subject=One%20free%20homepage%20finding%20from%20llms.txt&body=Homepage%20URL%3A%20%0ADesired%20visitor%20action%3A%20

For a site-specific First Screen Fix delivered before payment:
